name: Gamma
tagline: Gamma is an AI-native presentation and document tool that generates a complete, designed deck from a topic or outline in seconds. Rather than starting from a blank slide, you describe what you need and Gamma produces structured content you can refine, including text, images, charts, and embeds. It's become a favourite for people who need compelling presentations quickly but don't enjoy building them in PowerPoint.
